condition: When dayjs.tz.setDefault is in effect, calling dayjs.tz() on an ISO string with a 'Z' or offset ignores the offset and treats it as wall-clock time in the target zone, so every zone gives the same time.
workaround: Parse the string as UTC first and then convert it, e.g. dayjs.utc(str).tz('Asia/Hong_Kong') or dayjs(str).tz(zone), instead of dayjs.tz(str, zone).
